Each assignment/Data Safari link (e.g. "PS1") downloads the blank Quarto template (`.qmd`) — fill it in and render it yourself to produce your submission PDF. Tutorials and slides can be viewed with **Code → View Source** (top right of the page) if you'd like their `.qmd` source too.
:::

From Week 9 onward the course is organized around one idea: **common statistical tests are special cases of the linear model**, and we read every model with the [`marginaleffects`](https://marginaleffects.com) package (predictions, comparisons, and slopes in the units of the data).

## Graduate project milestones (BIOL 5860 only)

Four checkpoint deliverables spread across the semester, each documenting one stage of your independent project. See the [Assignments overview](assignments.qmd#project-graduate-students-only) for the full description. As with weekly assignments, click the name to download the blank `.qmd` template.

| Due by end of | Milestone | Template |
|----|----|:--:|
| Week 7 | Experimental design and planned hypothesis testing | <a href="templates/project-01-design-and-hypotheses.qmd" download="project-01-design-and-hypotheses.qmd">Part 1</a> |
| Week 10 | Data carpentry and exploration | <a href="templates/project-02-data-carpentry.qmd" download="project-02-data-carpentry.qmd">Part 2</a> |
| Week 13 | Statistical modeling | <a href="templates/project-03-statistical-modeling.qmd" download="project-03-statistical-modeling.qmd">Part 3</a> |
| Week 14 | Visualization | <a href="templates/project-04-visualization.qmd" download="project-04-visualization.qmd">Part 4</a> |
| Week 15 | Final presentation covering the entire process | — |

::: callout-note
These due dates are a suggested pacing (each milestone lands a week after the most relevant course content), not fixed by any particular constraint — adjust freely in this table and in the corresponding files' front matter if you'd prefer a different spread.
:::

## Notes

- Slides open as a separate reveal.js presentation (use arrow keys or click to advance); tutorials and assignments render as regular pages on this site.
- The graduate-only [Project](assignments.qmd#project-graduate-students-only) is presented in Week 15, alongside undergraduate project presentations.
